why: The project's 300 MW load assumes 121 diesel generators (2,500 kW each, total 302.5 MW) yielding an estimated NOx potential-to-emit of 1,067 tpy, exceeding the 100 tpy major-source threshold under 40 CFR 70.2 and triggering a federal Title V operating permit requirement. Washington County's moratorium (ORD-2026-12) is in effect as of 2026-10-26 with a computed expiration of 2026-12-27 (180 days from June 30, 2026) and pauses acceptance, processing, reviewing, and approval of all data center applications countywide. The moratorium's exemption for uses with a current Certificate of Use & Occupancy as of the effective date is noted in the ordinance, but the computed applicability indicates the moratorium applies to this site. The combination of an active local permitting block and a definite major federal air permit requirement means the project cannot proceed under current conditions.
